lines.ja: Don't wanna hear you calling out my name
lines.zh: 不想听到你呼唤我的名字

lines.ja: I'm not here for fortune and fame
lines.zh: 我来这里不是为了财富和名誉

lines.ja: Instead, I'll fight knowing nobody knows my name...
lines.zh: 相反，我会在知道没有人知道我名字的情况下战斗......

lines.ja: My foes are closing in and covering the sky!
lines.zh: 我的敌人正在逼近，遮天蔽日！

lines.ja: ...But I won't turn my back tonight!
I'll stay - until I taste the dirt of defeat someday...
lines.zh: 我会留下来——直到有一天我尝到失败的滋味……

lines.ja: Push on, prepared, fight fair and square
lines.zh: 继续前进，做好准备，公平正义地战斗

lines.ja: (Whats going on? All of my foes are gone)
lines.zh: （发生了什么事？我所有的敌人都消失了）

lines.ja: (Give me the heart, to cut through the dark and win!)
lines.zh: （给我一颗心，冲破黑暗，赢得胜利！）

lines.ja: Adrenaline is flowing through my brain
lines.zh: 肾上腺素流过我的大脑

lines.ja: With discipline and every hour that I've trained
lines.zh: 凭借纪律和我训练的每一个小时

lines.ja: The tallest mountain started as a stone
lines.zh: 最高的山最初是一块石头

lines.ja: I once was weak but now I've grown
lines.zh: 曾经的我很弱小，但现在我已经成长了

lines.ja: I know, the weakness within is my greatest foe
lines.zh: 我知道，内心的弱点是我最大的敌人

lines.ja: The mortal man I used to be has died
lines.zh: 我曾经的凡人已经死了

lines.ja: There's god's inside my fist tonight
lines.zh: 今晚上帝就在我的拳头里

lines.ja: I'll stay until I taste the dirt of defeat someday
lines.zh: 我会留下来，直到有一天我尝到失败的滋味
